bio: For centuries the Dusklit suffered under the rule of the Barons, cruel lords of the Nocturna. As generations passed, the memorium of the downtrodden gathered into a rage born of hunger and injustice. Now it is unleashed, a Titan built by fury, and all flee before the wrath of the Nocturna.
